mcu: TMS320F28379D class (C28x + FPU32 + TMU, 200 MHz, 1 MB flash, 204 KB RAM)
assumptions: single-issue compiled C, every FPU add/mul 2 cycles incl. load/store, TMU div/sqrt 8, compare+branch 4; no hand-written assembly, no CLA offload; figures are L1 estimates - no toolchain or hardware available

memory.note: LUT fits in flash or RAM of the F28379D; interpolation needs 8 reads

sampling.v1, v2: every period (100 kHz), 12-bit, synchronous with the EPWM period event; 0.25 / 0.12 V LSB
sampling.i2 period average: integrating sample (two ADC samples per period averaged, or hardware oversampling) at 100 kHz - needed by the observer-based MPCs and the RLS; the PI baseline does not need it
sampling.i_L peak: CT + peak detector (existing design) at 100 kHz for protection; not used by the controllers
sampling.RLS: can run decimated at 10 kHz (every 10th period) - its 1/L estimate changes slowly

fallback_logic.default: explicit MPC (LUT) when all plausibility checks pass
switch_to_PI_if: LUT inputs outside the table range for > 10 periods (e, V1 or P_hat)
RLS estimate 1/L outside [1/(1.3 L_nom), 1/(0.7 L_nom)] or P covariance not decreasing after 1000 updates
|v2 - v2_ref| > 5 % for > 2 ms (the LUT law should have settled in < 1 ms)
ISR overrun flag (EPWM period event before the previous ISR finished)
fallback_logic.switch_back: manual / supervisory only, after 100 ms in RUN with the PI and consistent estimates
fallback_logic.deterministic: PI and LUT paths are both fixed-iteration; the hand-over keeps the current phi and pre-loads the PI integrator with P = d_hat * v2 so the output is continuous
